messages:
sam: Quick check—I've uploaded orion-13b weights to s3://redwood-models/orion/13b/v1/weights.pt. Can someone confirm the tokenizer files location?

jia: Got it. tokenizer.json + merges at s3://redwood-models/orion/13b/v1/tokenizer/*

matt: Heads-up: tokenizer uses nonstandard BOS-token '<s>' and has additional special token '<|persona|>'. We should map them in config.

sam: thx. I'll add token_map in serving config. Any recommended max_seq_len? appears trained at 2048.

nina: yes model_max_length=2048. Also layernorm epsilon is 1e-5; if you put 1e-6 you see instability.

sam: Perf question: planning catalog perf runs tomorrow. Quick sanity on script?

matt: Use perf-runner v2:
```bash
perf-runner --model orion-13b --weights s3://redwood-models/orion/13b/v1/weights.pt --batch_sizes 1,4,8 --seq_len 512 --device gpu --runs 100
```

perf-bot: perf job queued (id: pj_20260317_01) :hourglass_flowing_sand: 

ops-jen: We'll reserve a2-large GPUs between 10-14 UTC for smoke tests.

jia: tokenizer note: merges file uses `\n` endings, some loaders choke. Use `tokenizer_loader: hf_bpe` in config.

sam: I'll push a small config PR and tag reviewers @jia @matt

matt: also add kv_cache_eviction=2048 to match sequence behavior.

nina: Perf hint: for orion, throughput jumps with batch 4 on A100 but latency tail increases. capture p95.

perf-bot: pj_20260317_01 finished: p50=78ms p95=210ms throughput=220 tok/s (batch=4, seq=512) :white_check_mark: 

sam: nice. can someone drop those numbers into the catalog entry? I can update model card after.

jia: I'll add tokenizer caveats (special tokens + loader) and include perf numbers. tagging @product for release notes :eyes: 

matt: LGTM on config, merge when tests pass.

sam: thanks all :thumbsup:
